article.title_en: SALT & SEA MISSION CHURCH INC.: food pantry in Brooklyn
article.summary_es: SALT & SEA MISSION CHURCH INC. es una despensa de alimentos en Brooklyn, aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
article.summary_en: SALT & SEA MISSION CHURCH INC. is a food pantry in Brooklyn, listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
Está ubicada en 2417 Stillwell Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11223.
Abre martes, jueves y domingo; vea los horarios en esta página.
Puede llamar al (917) 873-9261 para preguntar por los servicios.
La lista no indica qué alimentos entrega ni si hay requisitos; pregunte por teléfono.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 2417 Stillwell Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11223.
It is open Tuesday, Thursday and Sunday; see the hours on this page.
You can call (917) 873-9261 to ask about services.
The listing does not say what food is given or if there are requirements; ask by phone.
visit_tips_es: Llame antes de ir para confirmar los horarios y preguntar qué necesita llevar.
La despensa abre martes y jueves de 10:30am a 12:45pm, y el domingo de 10:30am a 10:45pm.
El horario del domingo es muy largo; confirme por teléfono a qué hora conviene llegar.
visit_tips_en: Call before you go to confirm the hours and ask what you need to bring.
The pantry is open Tuesday and Thursday from 10:30am to 12:45pm, and Sunday from 10:30am to 10:45pm.
Sunday hours are very long; call ahead to confirm the best time to arrive.

La lista no menciona requisitos ni documentos. Se recomienda llamar antes de ir para preguntar.
Sí. El domingo atiende de 10:30am a 10:45pm, según la lista.

faq_en.a: The listing does not say. Call (917) 873-9261 to ask what food is offered.

faq_en.q: Do I need documents or is there any requirement?
faq_en.a: The listing does not mention requirements or documents. It is best to call before going to ask.
Yes. On Sunday it is open from 10:30am to 10:45pm, according to the listing.
